text:
Noah Rivera: Heads-up: rolling out a limited preview of Dedicated H100v3 capacity in eu-north-1 (Stockholm) next week.
Noah Rivera: Purpose: validate multi-tenant cgroups + MIG-like partitioning, heatmap telemetry, and perf across our latest runtime. Preview is intentionally small and gated.
Priya Singh: TL;DR for sales/support: small pools, hourly billing for preview, early-adopter credit (10% off first 30d), no production SLA yet. Link to sign-up: https://internal.redwood/h100v3-preview-signup
Noah Rivera: Preview specifics:
- footprint: 1 pool per AZ across 3 AZs in eu-north-1 (initial capacity ~24 H100v3 GPUs total)
- per-org limit: up to 2 GPUs (contact for exceptions)
- partitioning: experimental multi-tenant partitions (non-exclusive) + dedicated pinning option for select customers
- reservation tag: `h100v3-preview-1` (30d rolling)
- billing: hourly usage, credits auto-applied for approved preview participants
Marcus Lee: Important perf note: our internal runs show improved throughput for long-context (>=4k) transformer inference vs H100v2, but results vary by quantization profile. We'll publish benchmark gist tomorrow.
Priya Singh: Customer comms: emphasise preview status (no SLA), expected throttles, and fallback behavior. Please use the short FAQ draft on the internal docs page.
Noah Rivera: Routing & fallback: default route prefers h100v3, fallback order: [h100v2, h100, a100]. Example config: `fallback_hw: ["h100v3", "h100v2", "a100"]`.
Marcus Lee: Driver/image note: the preview image uses NVIDIA 535.x stack + our runtime v2.9.0-rc.2. We observed one kernel OOM pattern at high-concurrency which is why this is preview-only.
ops-bot: [system] Quota updated: eu-north-1: +h100v3-preview (per-org cap = 2 GPUs).
pricing-bot: [system] Promo applied for approved preview orgs: 10% credit for first 30 days.
Priya Singh: Ops ask: @eng-sre please monitor p50/p95 latency, gpu_util, mem_pressure, and OOM counts during canary windows. We'll have extended trace-level logging enabled for the preview groups.
Noah Rivera: Runbook & rollback: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/h100v3-preview-runbook (includes steps to reprovision pools and force failover to fallback hardware).
Marcus Lee: Internal checklist being posted to the console: perf CSVs, kernel logs, and a short howto for reproducing the OOM case.
Priya Singh: Launch timeline: signups accepted until 2026-04-08, preview window: 2026-04-10 -> 2026-05-10.
Noah Rivera: If you have customers to nominate for the preview (esp. long-context workloads), add them via the form and tag me. We'll batch approvals every 48h.
Priya Singh: Quick reminder to billing & sales: preview is hourly; do not commit to reserved pricing in customer conversations. Use the FAQ & the promo clause.
Noah Rivera: Thanks team. Expect a short postmortem/summary at the end of the preview with recommendations for GA (capacity sizing, reservation model, SLA targets). :rocket:
